in_english.long_meaning: Bonifacio is a name that signifies good will and generosity, blessed and fruitful year, and innocence and purity of youth. The name is derived from the Latin word 'bonum facere', meaning 'to do good' or 'to be beneficial'. In Christian tradition, the name Bonifacio is associated with the virtues of benevolence and kindness. The name is also linked to the concept of a 'blessed year' or 'annus liber', symbolizing a period of freedom and liberation. Additionally, the name is associated with the purity and innocence of youth, reflecting the Christian values of moral integrity and spiritual purity.
